result.brief: 提出 VINO：以类 ViT 的 Volume Transformer 为骨干，重新设计学生-教师跨视图表征匹配、掩码几何预测与视图一致的 2D-to-3D 蒸馏，实现无标签 3D 场景语义表征学习。
result.reason: Self-supervised 3D scene representation learning with ViT-like volume transformer, redesigned student-teacher matching and masked prediction, plus 2D-to-3D distillation—directly a visual representation contribution.
